entries.title: Psalms 20:1
segments:
Defend thee; by the manifestation of his power and grace.  In these words the church prays for her divinely appointed head. 
 
The manifestations of the perfections of God are a sure protection of his people, and those who trust in him will find him an habitual and all sufficient defence.

entries.title: Psalms 20:2
segments: From the sanctuary--out of Zion; where God dwelt between the cherubim.

entries.title: Psalms 20:5
segments:
In thy salvation; in the salvation granted to thee, our king, by God. 
 
Those who form their plans and undertake their enterprises in the name of the Lord, and for the purpose of honoring him, will find in him a ground of dependence more safe and more efficacious than fleets and armies, or any aid that mere creatures can afford.

entries.title: Psalms 20:6
segments: His anointed; David was the Lord's anointed, and as such was a type of the Messiah.

entries.title: Psalms 20:7
segments: The name of the Lord; his manifestations of himself in behalf of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 20:8
segments: They are brought down; those who trust in earthly help,

entries.title: Psalms 20:9
segments: The King; King of heaven, Jehovah.
